Global dairy inputs from Rasmussen et al. (2024), at their means

Source: R/examples.R
example_global_dairy.Rd

Global (herd-size weighted) lactational incidence (prevalence for PTB) from Table 2, pooled inter-disease odds ratios from Table 3, and raw yield (% decrease) and fertility (% increase in calving interval) impacts from Table 4. Pairs absent from Table 3 are treated as independent, as in the paper. Culling impacts (hazard ratios) are omitted; see hr_to_risk().

Usage

example_global_dairy()

Value

A cm_model() with outcomes "yield" and "fertility".

Details

The paper's Table 5 reports means of adjusted impacts over Monte Carlo draws, which differ from adjusting the input means (e.g. displaced abomasum yield: 1.18 vs 0.79).
